**Big: 1,291 uses in 94 files. Four spots keep the old name.**

- `docs/openapi.yaml` names the public fields. Frozen.
- `lib/serialize.js` right-side names. Same public fields.
- `vendor/reporting-sdk` is generated. A refresh overwrites edits.
- `migrations/*.sql` already ran. Editing them changes nothing.

The database column needs its own new migration.
